instagram.author: kellykkroberts
instagram.body:
Part 4 of how I built the @badassladygang app without knowing how to code. Most people when they say they have an app white label software. It’s kind of like buying a blank shirt, putting your logo on it and sell it. I would have LOVED to have done that but no one would make what I needed. I BEGGED. I got ghosted by so many people and companies. So, I built it myself with @claudeai. It was wildly hard. It still is wildly hard. But it’s better than I ever imagined and it’s going to help so many people. 

The feature list i have to make after the android app gets built is LONG. 
-GPS
-Audio guided runs
-an anti-diet culture focus corner to fueling and building body resilience
-spin classes
-triathlon support 
-maybe one day if @garminrunning ever decides to give me access to the developer program, I can integrate with them. Been waiting since March but hey, I’m patient. @corosglobal too. Didn’t even get an email back from them after applying for their API 🥲
The list is long. But for now, just fixing everything has been a journey. But the @badassladygang is available in the App Store or on BALGTraining.com 

If running taught me anything it’s that nothing is impossible. I can do hard things though right now, I kind of wish I’d do easy things more. 😂

What features do you want to see????
